patterns.note: Asymmetrical page layout featuring a persistent, sticky left-aligned navigation panel that slides into view on scroll, creating a two-column structure for the main content area.

Integration of small, colored, numbered tags (e.g., '2.3', '2.1') directly within prominent headings to denote versions or specific data points, lending a technical and precise character to the typography.

Strategic use of vibrant, almost primary-colored accents (blue, red, yellow, green, purple) on an otherwise muted, off-white background, primarily for small interactive elements, version tags, and abstract graphics, providing visual pops without overwhelming the minimalist aesthetic.
A left-aligned navigation panel slides smoothly into view from the left edge of the screen and becomes sticky at the top-left corner as the user scrolls down the page.
A large, semi-transparent brand name ('Poolside') is fixed in the background of the footer section, subtly revealing itself as the main content scrolls over it, creating a layered depth effect.

technique_notes: Implement a left-aligned navigation panel that is initially hidden or partially off-screen, then slides smoothly into view from the left and fixes its position to the top-left of the viewport once the user scrolls past a certain point.
Create a large, subtle brand name in the footer that acts as a fixed background element, allowing the foreground content to scroll over it and reveal it gradually, giving a sense of depth.
Utilize a clean, spacious card-based layout for presenting features and articles, with subtle rounded corners and consistent internal padding, maintaining visual hierarchy and readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, impactful headings (approx. 3-4x body text) with standard body text and small, often uppercase, functional labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its asymmetrical layout with a persistent, sliding-in left navigation, combined with a large, subtly revealing brand name in the footer. This creates a unique layered browsing experience that feels both modern and academically rigorous, using vibrant color accents sparingly to highlight key technical information.
